title: MegaCLS
description: A modern German Minecraft server network featuring CityBuild, Creative-CB, SMP and BedWars.
body:
# MegaCLS

Welcome to **MegaCLS**, a modern German Minecraft server network focused on performance, community, and unique gameplay experiences.

## Available Game Modes
- **CityBuild**
- **Creative-CB**
- **SMP**
- **BedWars**
- Seasonal events & special community projects

## Features
- Modern high-performance infrastructure
- Active development & regular updates
- Cross-version support
- Cross-platform support (Java & Bedrock)
- Community events
- Stable economy & progression systems
- Custom features & quality of life improvements

## Our Goal
MegaCLS aims to combine classic Minecraft gameplay with modern systems, polished performance, and a strong community experience — whether you want to build, survive, compete, or just have fun with friends.

Join us and become part of the MegaCLS community.
